change: Final shared-run simplification preserves exact visible curves, matching/Anti pairing, branch anchors and the woven mask. Each shared run has one replacement used by every occurrence. Canonical fits and self-reversed half fits preserve related subdivisions. Full geometry and paper checks remain required.

fixed.method: The original exported geometry supplies the reference weave, not an optimizer initialization. Time includes the complete cleanup and its acceptance checks. Original loading, creation of the 400-cell reference mask, independent 800-cell exported rendering, comparison and subsequent paper checks are outside the timer. Exact binary export equality and fractional coverage drift <0.005 percentage points are required. Cut endpoints, matching templates, requested symmetry, geometry and paper gates must remain valid. A declined simplification is unchanged, not a failed design.
